create_llm_with_torch_profiler: create an LLM instance with torch profiler config pointing to a profiler output directory
create_sampling_params: create a SamplingParams object with temperature and top_p values for text generation
run_llm_generate: run the LLM generate method with a list of prompts and sampling parameters
start_llm_profiling: start torch profiling on an LLM instance before generating text
stop_llm_profiling: stop torch profiling on an LLM instance after generating text
